title: Faithfulness of CoT Degrades Under Task Difficulty: A Controlled Variation

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If monitoring is less reliable on easy tasks, agents are hardest to monitor when they have spare capacity for manipulation. This paradox has direct implications for monitoring system design and threat modeling.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Stratifying existing MALT data and applying prompted monitors. Uses existing metadata for difficulty. No model training needed. API-based evaluation. Very accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three difficulty strata, one monitor, AUROC per stratum. Uses existing MALT data without generating new data. Clean analysis project. Well within 30 hours.
